_doc: PHÉP THỬ: vẽ lại toàn bộ hình Unit 1 bằng Gemini để so với bản cắt từ sách và bản tìm trên mạng. Mọi hình ở unit này hiện ở 64–80px nên ô 5×5 (204px) thừa gấp 2,5. Xem scripts/gen_grid.py.
style: Style: simple friendly flat illustration for a 7-year-old science book, bright clear colours, bold simple shapes that stay readable when shrunk very small, one single clear subject, plain white background in every cell.

words.compare: two round fruits side by side with a magnifying glass between them, one red and one green
words.habitat: an old stone wall with a small green plant growing out of a crack in it, the wall as its home
words.label: a simple plant drawing with three small blank tags on strings pointing at flower, leaf and root
words.model: a glass fish tank set inside an open box, with water, gravel, a plant and two fish — a small made copy of a real habitat
words.environment: a landscape showing sky, a river and green land all together
words.home: a cosy bird nest tucked in a tree branch with a bird sitting in it
words.local: a map with a house in the middle and a small circle drawn close around it
words.crack: a paving stone split by a thin line with a small green plant growing up out of it
words.describe: a child pointing at an object and speaking, with a speech bubble containing simple shapes
words.desert: a wide sandy desert with tall dunes under a bright sun and a clear sky, no plants
words.photograph: a camera with a printed photo of a tree coming out of it
words.pretend: a child wearing a paper animal mask and crawling on all fours, acting as if they were that animal
words.record: a child writing and drawing what they see in an open notebook
words.attract: a bright flower with a bee flying towards it along a dotted curved line
words.clues: a magnifying glass held over a set of small animal footprints on soil
words.droppings: small dark animal droppings on the ground beside a rabbit
words.egg: a single bird egg in a nest, with a faint chick shape visible inside
words.hide: a small mouse peeking out from behind a tree trunk, mostly hidden
words.insect: one beetle and one ant side by side, seen from above
words.scare: a bird flying away quickly from a scarecrow with its wings spread
words.tracks: a line of animal paw prints pressed into soft mud
words.absorb: a sponge soaking up a puddle of water, water lines going into it
words.explosive: a rocky hillside with a burst of grey dust and small rock pieces flying up, seen from far away
words.gravel: a heap of small smooth river stones
words.mine: a deep underground tunnel with a miner in a helmet holding a lamp

words.sample: a gloved hand dropping one small stone into a plain clear glass jar
words.stones: a small pile of grey rounded stones
words.swirl: water turning round and round in a glass with curved arrows showing the spin
words.waterproof: a roof of flat grey slate tiles in the rain, droplets bouncing off
words.litter: a sandy beach with a plastic bottle, a paper bag and a crumpled wrapper on the sand
words.material: a wooden spoon, a metal fork, a glass jar and a plastic bottle in a row
words.nature reserve: a fenced green reserve with trees, a pond, birds and deer inside it

words.protect: two cupped hands held around a small growing seedling
words.recycle: the three-arrow recycling triangle symbol in green
words.habitat-wall: an old stone wall with small green plants and moss growing out of its cracks
words.cactus: a tall green cactus in dry cracked desert ground under a strong sun
words.insect-hotel: a bug hotel made of bundled hollow sticks in a wooden frame, with bees around it
words.quarry-big: a wide quarry dug into a hillside with bare rock steps, no plants left on it

words.force: a hand pushing a box and another hand pulling a rope, arrows showing both directions

words.pull: a child pulling a wagon towards themselves, an arrow pointing towards them
words.away: a ball rolling off to the right with a long arrow pointing away from a standing child
words.towards: a ball rolling closer to a standing child with a long arrow pointing at the child
words.stretch: two hands pulling a rubber band so it becomes long and thin
words.squash: a hand pressing down on a soft plastic bottle, making it bulge
words.launch: a small paper rocket shooting upward off a bottle with a puff below it
words.rocket: a simple paper rocket with a pointed nose and fins
words.shape: a lump of clay beside the same clay pressed into a flat pancake
words.object: a wooden spoon, a ball and a book grouped together
words.measure: a tower of stacked counting bricks beside a ball, showing how high

words.investigate: a child in goggles carefully dropping a ball and watching it land
words.results: an open notebook with a simple two-column table drawn in it, cells empty
words.pattern: four clay balls in a row, each one flatter than the one before
words.speed: a bicycle racing along with speed lines streaming behind it

words.slow down: a bicycle with a falling arrow behind it and the rider braking

words.explain: a child pointing at a simple drawing and talking, a speech bubble with shapes in it
words.direction: a curved arrow showing a path bending from going one way to going another way
words.turn: a small boat on water curving round, leaving a curved wake behind it
words.diagram: a plain line drawing of a ball and an arrow with two small blank pointer tags
